DETAILS OF GALLANTRY AWARDEE 
(CHAKRA SERIES) 
 
Name:  LIEUTENANT COLONEL MANEO FRANCIS PF, SC 
 
Award Recommended  KIRTI CHAKRA  
Effective Date of Award  29 OCTOBER 2025  
Personnel No  IC-76640X 
Rank & Decorations, if any  LIEUTENANT COLONEL 
Unit  21ST BATTALION THE  
PARACHUTE REGIMENT 
(SPECIAL FORCES) 
Whether Posthumous  NO  
Father’s Name K PUKEHO  
Mother’s Name H SAZA SUSAN 
CITATION 
 
29 October-04 November 2025  
 
Lieutenant Colonel Maneo  Francis PF, SC, the Assault Team Commander of a 
Parachute Regiment (Special Forces), swiftly established a highly coordinated intelligence 
network to systematically dismantle anti-national elements fueling violence and division in 
Manipur. 
                                                                                                                              
 After a several months of sustained intelligence development about a high profile 
violent insurgent group and target specific tea m training, he launched a coordinated 
operation to raid and dismantle the insurgents. Following seven days of protracted and 
intense surveillance the team approach the hide out and demanded the insurgent to 
peacefully surrender. The insurgent opened heavy automatic fire in denial. Lieutenant 
Colonel Francis maneuvered his assault group from the north of the hide out and 
successfully eliminated one sentry. Subsequently he outflanked another insurgent who had 
pinned down the entire assault group, the officer crawled under heavy fire with utter 
disregard to his safety and eliminated him in a close quarter combat with his superior 
combat skills. 
 
For displaying resolute leadership, superior tactical acumen, the raw courage under 
fire in eliminating two heavy arm ed insurgents, meticulous planning, gallant and selfless 
acts, Lieutenant Colonel  Maneo Francis PF, SC  is recommended for the award of  
“KIRTI CHAKRA”.

DETAILS OF GALLANTRY AWARDEE 
(CHAKRA SERIES) 
 
Name:  MAJOR JITENDRA RATHEE 
 
Award Recommended  KIRTI CHAKRA  
Effective Date of Award  22 FEB 2025  
Personnel No  IC-80956F 
Rank & Decorations, if any  MAJOR  
Unit  2ND BATTALION THE 
PARACHUTE REGIMENT 
(SPECIAL FORCES) 
Whether Posthumous  NO  
Father’s Name SHRI OMPRAKASH 
Mother’s Name SMT KAMALA DEVI 
CITATION 
  
22 February 2025 
 
          Major Jitendra Rathee, a highly skilled Special Forces officer operating in Kishtwar 
region was entrusted with the mission of neutralising terrorist groups in the area. 
 
          On 22 February 2025, acting on precise intelligence regarding terrorist presence in 
a hideout in jungles of, district Kishtwar, Major Jitendra swiftly led his squad to the target. 
At 0800 hours, he expertly readjusted the cordon to seal all escape routes and started the 
search. Displaying exceptional courage, he moved dangerously close to the hideout and 
with remarkable presence of mind, he deployed canine ‘Tyson’ inside the hideout which 
drew heavy and indiscriminate terrorist fire. Undeterred and recognising imminent threat to 
his men and the canine, he delivered precise covering fire ensuring their safe extraction. 
 
         Exhibiting tactical brilliance under intense hostile fire, the officer maneuvered 
stealthily to an advantageous position, identified a hiding terrorist and with decisive action, 
lobbed incendiary grenades eliminating a terrorist and set fire to the hideout thereby 
trapping and injuring the other two terrorists. After cessation of fire, he closed in to take 
confirmatory shots neutralising total three foreign terrorists. 
 
         For his conspicuous bravery, indomitable spirit and exceptional leadership under fire, 
Major Jitendra Rathee is recommended for the award of “KIRTI CHAKRA”.

Name:  HAVILDAR GAJENDRA SINGH 
 
Award Recommended  KIRTI CHAKRA (POSTHUMOUS)

Personnel No  13627256K 
Rank & Decorations, if any  HAVILDAR 
Unit  2ND BATTALION THE 
PARACHUTE REGIMENT 
(SPECIAL FORCES) 
Whether Posthumous  YES  
Father’s Name SHRI DHAN SINGH GARIYA 
Mother’s Name SMT CHANDRA GARIYA 
CITATION 
18 January 2026 
       
 
       Havildar Gajendra Singh serving as Intelligence Troop Havildar, focused relentlessly 
on a specific jungle area of Kishtwar District and confirmed it as primary terrorist hideout 
area. 
 
      On 18 January 2026, leading a search team in dense jungles at an altitude in excess 
of 3000 meter in Kishtwar, he detec ted a suspected hideout near a vertical cliff. Sensing 
threat, he advanced cautiously and ascertained terrorist presence at extremely close 
range. His challenge, promoted them to unleash a barrage of fire that wounded both scouts. 
 
       Fearlessly charging forward, Hav Gajendra evacuated the first scout to safety and 
administered vital life-saving first aid. Ignoring his own peril, he then extracted the second 
wounded comrade during which he sustained multiple bullet wounds. Only after securing 
both he did retreat to a safe zone from where despite profuse bleeding he re-engaged the 
terrorists and critically injured a most wanted foreign terrorist. Havildar Gajendra Singh 
succumbed to his injuries on site, embodying the Indian Army’s finest traditions of selfless 
sacrifice and camaraderie. 
 
        For his extraordinary leadership, unyielding courage, bravery in saving his comrades’ 
lives and incapacitated a foreign terrorist at ultimate personal cost , Havildar Gajendra 
Singh is recommended for the award of “KIRTI CHAKRA (POSTHUMOUS)”.

Name:  MAJOR ADITYA PRATAP SINGH, SC, SM

Personnel No  IC-87240L 
Rank & Decorations, if any  MAJOR

44 ASSAM RIFLES  
Whether Posthumous  NO  
Father’s Name LATE HARI PRATAP SINGH  
Mother’s Name SMT VIMLA SINGH  
CITATION  
 05 July 2025 
 
      On 05 July 2025, Major Aditya Pratap Singh, SC, SM led his team on a patrol on an 
isolated track along Indo-Myanmar border through a thickly forested treacherous terrain. 
At 0445 hours, the patrol came under intense automatic and grenade fire from 
insurgents. 
 
 Displaying exceptional courage, presence of mind and tactical acumen, the officer 
retaliated with lighting speed and sensing danger to his scout, he pulled him to cover 
and had a close shave with insurgents’ fire hitting his backpack. Unmindful of the grave 
risk to his own life and in a display of unparalleled resilience and raw courage, the officer 
crawled forward under heavy fire sustaining splinter injuries while closing in with the 
insurgents. Undeterred by his injuries and with utter disregard to personal safety, he 
charged towards the insurgent stronghold amidst incoming fire. Displaying superlative 
field craft, he lobbed a grenade and engaged with accurate fire, eliminating a most 
wanted top operational commander of a high profile insurgent gr oup at close quarters 
recovering huge cache of war like stores. 
 
 For displaying indomitable courage despite injuries and conspicuous bravery 
beyond the call of duty, Major Aditya Pratap Singh, SC, SM  is recommend for the 
award of "BAR TO SHAURYA CHAKRA".

Whether Posthumous  NO  
Father’s Name SHRI BIPIN BIHARI 
Mother’s Name SMT NEELAM KUMARI 
CITATION 
26 Aug 2025  
 
 Major Paramveer led an ambush in a Nala along the LC in general Area Machhadi. 
Demonstrating outstanding tactical appreciation of terrain, he sited his ambush at a daring 
range of 15 –20 meters from the killing ground, employing concealment to achieve total 
surprise. 
 
 As the terrorists moved into the killing ground, he with exempla ry composure, 
sprang the ambush with devastating effect, bringing down accurate fire engaging all three 
terrorists effectively. One terrorist attempting escape despite injuries, jumped downhill. 
With utter disregard to personal safety, Major Paramveer brok e cover, pursued and 
neutralised the terrorist. 
 
 During follow -up search, he demonstrated keen observation, spotted and 
eliminated second terrorist who was concealed behind dense bushes on the far bank of 
Naushera Nar. Thereafter, he identified the third terrorist behind a boulder and ordered 
his elimination. The operation also led to the recovery of huge war-like stores. 
 
 With resolute leadership Major Paramveer ensured complete destruction of the 
infiltrating group without own casualties. For his conspi cuous gallantry and devotion to 
duty beyond the call, Major Paramveer is recommended for the award of “SHAURYA 
CHAKRA”.

CITATION 
13 October 2025  
 
 Major Tarun Vasudevan, 57 Rashtriya Rifles Battalion (Rajputana Rifles) led 
ambush column from front, ensuring elimination of hardcore terrorists during a Counter 
Infiltration Operation. 
 
 On receiving specific intelligence inputs of likely infiltration/Border Action Team by 
terrorists, Major Tarun Vasudevan planned and led one of the ambush columns in the 
general area in close proximity to enemy post. 
 
 On being informed by scout about movement of two heavily armed terrorists, he 
displayed exceptional tactical acumen, raw courage and complete disregard to personal 
safety and ensured that terrorists were lured close to ambush location. He engaged the 
terrorists at close distance, resulting in heavy retaliation from terrorists who then tried to 
flee towards Shamshu Nar. However, he continued with close quarter battle and in ensuing 
intense firefight, eliminated one heavily armed hardcore terrorist. Not letting terrorist break 
contact, he continued to engage the other terrorist by firing on move and claymore firing, 
ensuring his elimination by next column.  
 
 For displaying unparalleled raw courage, resolute leadership, and impeccable  
tactical acumen with comp lete disregard to his personal safety resulting in elimination of 
two heavily armed hardcore terrorists, Major Tarun Vasudevan is recommended for the 
award of “SHAURYA CHAKRA”.

(RETD) 
Mother’s Name SMT ASHA DEVI 
CITATION 
 
02 February 2026 
 
 Post the persistent efforts of Major Keshav Kumar during an Operation wherein one 
terrorist was eliminated, credible intelligence was received on 02 February 2026 regarding 
two terrorists in a forest. As Mission Commander of an Operation, Major Keshav Kumar 
displayed exceptional ingenuity by induct ing through unlikely routes across treacherous 
terrain to achieve complete surprise. During the night, he tactically occupied likely escape 
routes, inching closer to the suspected hideout maintaining close surveillance over the 
area. 
 
 On the following mor ning, he initiated a deliberate search and personally cleared 
four caves narrowing down the suspected hideout, putting himself in grave danger to 
pressure the terrorist. When the terrorists opened indiscriminate fire, revealing their 
position, displaying c omposure under fire and maintaining inter -agency fire coordination, 
he continued to engage them, leading to elimination of one terrorist . With the second 
terrorist hol d up inside the cave, his actions proved pivotal in preventing the terrorists 
escape and subsequent neutralization. 
  
 The neutralized terrorist , was later identified as Category A++ terrorist and was 
responsible for multiple killing of security personnel and civilians. 
 
 For the conspicuous gallantry and indomitable courage under fire, Major Keshav 
Kumar is recommended for the award of “SHAURYA CHAKRA”.

SINGH BRIJWAL 
Mother’s Name SMT RADHA BRIJWAL 
CITATION 
 
07 November 2025 
 
 On 07 November 2025, during a Counter Infiltration Operation Major Gaurav Singh 
Brijwal was leading a 48 -hours ambush ahead of the fence in proximity to the Line of 
Control. At last light, he was informed of a suspicious movement of three terrorists along 
the Line of Control. Displaying exceptional composure and tactical acumen, he allowed the 
terrorist group to reach close to his location in desired killing ground. After positively 
identifying the terrorists with their weapons, Major Gaurav with his accurate fire, injured the 
leading terrorist. 
 
 Sensing danger to his own troops due to retaliatory fire by the terrorists, he shifted 
his position under heavy fire with total disregard to his personal safety and neutralized the 
first terrorist at close range. Observing the remaining terroris ts attempting to escape, he 
directed his covering party to engage them, effectively preventing their retreat. He then 
personally engaged and injured the second terrorist. 
 
 Major Gaurav exemplary combat leadership and tactical acumen under intense 
enemy fire led to the neutralization of two terrorists and elimination of an infiltration bid 
along the Line of Control. For his gallant action and devotion to duty, Major Gaurav Singh 
Brijwal is recommended for the award of “SHAURYA CHAKRA”.

Mother’s Name SMT ANITA SINGH 
 
 
 
 
 
CITATION 
 
21 February 2026 
 
  The officer displayed exceptional tactical skills and battlefield leadership during the 
counter-terrorist operation conducted on 21-22 February 2026 in Kishtwar District.  Tasked 
with leading the inner cordon in extremely difficult jungle and mountainous terrain, he 
executed deliberate closing-in-drills under hostile conditions to reduce distance with well -
entrenched terrorists. 
 
 On detection of hostile presence, he maneuvered his team through undergrowth 
and uneven ground, maintaining stealth while domin ating escape routes.  When the 
terrorists attempted to break contact, the officer led from the front and engaged them in a 
fierce close-quarter gunfight. In the intense exchange of fire, he accurately engaged and 
critically injured one terrorist, effective ly pinning him down and disrupting any attempt to 
escape and kept him trapped in cordoned dhok, enabling the containment grid to tighten.  
His resolute leadership and maintenance of absolute surprise till establishment of close 
cordon has led to successful trapping of terrorists in a dhok and further led to neutralization 
of a dreaded terrorist in most challenging operational environments. Officer’s decisive 
actions and exemplary leadership under fire reflect the highest standards of 
professionalism. 
 
 For his courage, exemplary leadership and utmost professionalism, Major Vipeen 
Kumar is recommended for the award of “SHAURYA CHAKRA”.

Name:  NAIB SUBEDAR SHANKAR RAM 
Award Recommended  SHAURYA CHAKRA

Unit  3 ASSAM RIFLES  
Whether Posthumous  NO  
Father’s Name LATE BAHADUR RAM  
Mother’s Name LATE MADHAVI DEVI  
CITATION  
         
28 November 2025 
           On 28 November 2025 , Naib Subedar Shankar Ram displayed conspicuous 
gallantry when his Post in Imphal East district of Manipur came under intense fire from 
insurgents. Exhibiting nerves of steel and bravery of the highest order, he immediately 
retaliated by bringing accurate MMG fire  on insurgent positions. During the ensuing 
fire-fight, he sustained a grievous injury to his left hand . Though bleeding profusely , 
with utter disregard to his personal safety , he refused evacuation a nd continued to 
exhort the troops to fight. Demonstrating indomitable courage and an unyielding 
fighting spirit, he switched to his personal weapon and single -handedly re-engaged 
insurgents under withering hostile fire  despite grave danger. His r esolute ac tion 
resulted in critical injuries to six insurgents, thereby forcing them to retreat across the 
border. 
 
        Displaying exceptional presence of mind, he detected a hostile bomb-laden drone 
and immediately alerted troops thereby averted own casualties.  His actions were 
instrumental in the recovery of two automatic weapons and war like stores. 
 
 For this daring action beyond the call of duty, Naib Subedar Shankar Ram is 
recommended for the Award of “SHAURYA CHAKRA”.

Whether Posthumous  NO

Mother’s Name SMT BASANTI DEVI  
CITATION  
  
04 November 2025 
 
          Naib Subedar Dabbal Singh Bisht a seasoned and experienced junior leader of the 
Special Forces demonstrated exceptional operational acumen and gallantry during the 
firefight with a violent insurgent group in the general area Churachandpur, Manipur. 
 
 On 04 November 2025, acting on specific intelligence inputs regarding the presence 
of heavily armed insurgent cadres in general area Churachandpur, the Junior 
Commissioned Officer led his troops to establish a cordon along with his Team Commander 
Lieutenant Colonel Maneo Francis PF, SC. Upon instructions from his Team Commander, 
Naib Subedar Dabbal Singh Bisht took cover alongside his squad when a group of armed 
cadres attempting to breach their cordon site. In the face of indiscriminate enemy fire and 
without regard to personal safety, Naib Subedar Dabbal Singh Bisht engaged them and 
trapped them in a kill zone. One cadre tried to out maneuver him from the West flank, with 
due diligence and tactical acumen, he crawled to a cover and engaged the cadre with 
precise and quick engagement. Despite  being under heavy fire, his exceptional 
marksmanship and courageous pursuit resulted in pinning down one insurgent and injuring 
two insurgents and thereby eliminating one insurgent. 
 
 Tactical leadership and tactical brilliance of the junior commissioned officer was 
instrumental in thwarting the insurgents. For his extraordinary valour and leadership, going 
beyond call of duty, Naib Subedar Dabbal Singh Bisht is recommended for the award of                  
“SHAURYA CHAKRA”.

Mother’s Name SMT SHAKUNTLA DEVI 
CITATION  
03 February 2026 
 
           Havildar Jagattar Singh during an Operation displayed conspicuous gallantry and 
exemplary soldierly qualities in the dense and rugged terrain of general area Jofar Forest. 
On 02 February 2026, based on a credible intelligence input regarding the presence of 
two hardcore terrorists, Havildar Jagatta r Singh volunteered for covert tasks and along 
with his buddy, moved stealthily to observe, verify and track the hostile element operating 
in the area.  Exhibiting outstanding Field Craft and composure, he maintained discreet 
surveillance, confirmed terrorist presence and facilitated timely induction of own troops, 
thereby enabling the operation to progress to a decisive stage.  
 
 On 03 February 2026, during the subsequent deliberate search and domination of 
the suspected hide, he tactically sited his squad to cover the most likely escape route and 
to deny breakout from the cave complex.  In the ensuing engagement, the terrorists 
launched grenades and intense small arms fire from within the hide in an attempt to break 
the cordon and escape. Undeterred by dir ect enemy fire, Havildar Jagattar Singh 
maintained his position with exceptional calmness and vigilance. When one terrorist 
attempted to force an escape during the exchange of fire, he displayed raw courage, 
exemplary marksmanship and presence of mind, eng aged the terrorist at close quarters 
and neutralised him instantly, despite the grave risk to his own life from continuing hostile 
fire and grenade blasts. 
 
 Thereafter, displaying unwavering devotion to duty, he continued to play a pivotal 
role in the clearance of the hide and advancing under threat, conducted a thorough search 
and assisted in the safe extraction of terrorist bodies and recoveries, ensuring successful 
culmination of the operation.    
 
 For his conspicuous gallantry, resolute courage under direct enemy fire and astute 
leadership, Havildar Jagattar Singh  is recommended for the award of “SHAURYA 
CHAKRA”.

Whether Posthumous  YES

Mother’s Name SMT ROSHNI DEVI 
CITATION 
      
  08 September 2025 
 
       During a Joint Search and Destroy Operation in the Forest area of district Kulgam for 
Lance Naik Narender Sindhu  displayed exceptional bravery and eliminated a hardcore  
terrorist while making supreme sacrifice. 
 
       On 08 September 2025, at 0815 hours, terrorists from a hideout opened indiscriminate 
fire on the search column and attempted escape.  Despite indiscriminate fire, Narender 
Sindhu with his exemplary composure and tactical clarity, withheld his fire to avoid casualty 
to own search parties who were positioned inside the cordon. On detecting suspicious 
movement at close quarters, he boldly challenged the terrorist as per the rules of 
engagement. The terrorist re taliated with intense fire injuring Narender Sindhu. Despite 
grievously wounded in retaliatory fire, Narender Sindhu displayed raw courage and 
remarkable initiative, maneuvered under fire, re -adjusted his position and engaged the 
terrorist with accurate and lethal fire, killing him on the spot. The terrorist later identified as 
Category A+. Lance Naik Narender Sindhu was later evacuated but succumbed to his 
injuries. 
 
       For his act of indomitable courage, gallant action of the highest order and supreme  
sacrifice in the finest traditions of the Indian Army, Lance Naik Narender Sindhu  is 
recommended for the award of “SHAURYA CHAKRA (POSTHUMOUS)”.

CITATION  
 
 
04 February 2026  
  
 A Counter terrorist operation was launched on 14 January 2026 in General Area 
Kishtwar. During the operation, a massive hideout was busted on 18 January 2026, 
however terrorists managed to flee owing to dense forest. Post this, search operation was 
launched to neutralise terrorists who fled, wherein Lance Naik Kapil Dev was nominated to 
lead as scout of one of the Ghatak operation team.  
 
 At around 1815 hours, on 04 February 2026, Lance Naik Kapil Dev spotted a 
terrorist hiding in the densely forested area of Dichhar behind trees. Exhibiting exceptional 
courage and tactical skills, he inched closer alongwith his buddy towards the terrorist. Once 
in close proximity, unmindful of his personal safety as he was fired upon from two different 
directions by other terrorists,  he engaged the terrorist with accurate fire . With bold and 
courageous actions, he eliminated one terrorist, ensured safety of own column and led to 
recovery of arms, ammunition and war like stores. 
 
 Upholding highest tradition of Indian Army, Lance Naik Kapil Dev  displayed 
indomitable courage beyond the call of duty during the operation. 
 
           For his act of bravery in the face of enemy, Lance Naik Kapil Dev is recommended 
for award of “SHAURYA CHAKRA”.

CITATION  
23 January 2026 
 
      Sepoy Jaswinder Singh demonstrated raw courage and mettle in eliminating 
armed foreign terrorist during high risk house intervention operation in remote village 
of Kathua district.    
       On 23 January 2026, despite heavy rainfall Sepoy Jaswinder Singh led an assault 
team with tactical audacity and excellent battle  craft through dense foliage, 
approaching the target house with surprise.  He ensured visual contact with support 
team and obtained positive confirmation of no civilian presence inside house.  With 
utter disregard to personal safety, he led the deliberate search of house through 
alternate entry.  He correctly appreciated presence of terrorist with weapon inside 
kitchen.  Realizing grave danger to his team, Sepoy Jaswinder Singh s wiftly dashed 
towards the terrorist and neutralised him with effective fire from personal weapon in 
close encounter.  His presence of mind and sheer grit denied any reaction time to 
terrorist, thereby concluding the operation in merely few minutes.   
      The daring act by Sepoy Jasw inder led to neutralisation of one drafed terrorist 
responsible for numerous terrorist incidents in Kathua district since 2024 and recover 
of M-4 Assault Rifles including other warlike stores.  
      For conspicuous bravery, fearlessness and daring in eliminating a foreign terrorist, 
Sepoy Jaswinder Singh is recommended for the award of “SHAURYA CHAKRA”.
